rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone no longer has something or it has gone missing.

example.english: I lose my phone all the time, and it drives me crazy.
example.traditional: 我成日唔小心整冇咗部手機，激死我喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 mou5 zo2 bou6 sau2 gei1 gik1 sei2 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being defeated in a game, match, competition, or contest.

example.english: If we keep playing like this, we lose the match.
example.traditional: 一陣再咁踢，我哋就輸場波喇。
example.jyutping: jat1 zan6 zoi3 gam2 tek3 ngo5 dei6 zau6 syu1 coeng4 bo1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone gets lost and cannot find the way.

example.english: I lose my way every time I walk around that area.
example.traditional: 我每次去嗰頭行吓行吓都蕩失路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 ci3 heoi3 go2 tau4 haang4 haa5 haang4 haa5 dou1 dong6 sat1 lou6

rows.note: Use this when you can no longer keep following or tracking a person or thing.

example.english: The bus is going too fast, so I lose sight of it.
example.traditional: 架巴士開得太快，我跟唔到喇。
example.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 hoi1 dak1 taai3 faai3 ngo5 gan1 m4 dou2 laa3
